content.value: Frontend (React) Beginner module 1 on React Fundamentals. In this lesson you will understand the core idea, break it into practical tasks, and apply it in a mini build. Start with the fundamentals of why this topic matters, then walk through a step by step implementation flow with common mistakes to avoid. By the end, you should be able to explain the concept, implement it from scratch, and connect it to a larger project architecture with confidence.
